description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteThingStrategy class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing the behavior of the delete operation for a 'thing' entity within the persistence layer.

classes.name: DeleteThingStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteThingStrategy, testing immutability and deletion functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DeleteThingStrategy instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DeleteThingStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteThing
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a thing entity and verifies the correct response and event are produced.

calls: assertModificationResult(underTest, THING_V2, command, ThingDeleted.class, DeleteThingResponse.of(context.getState(), command.getDittoHeaders()), true)
